audits.year_separation_policy: 2016 and 2018 facility values are useful independent lineage/crosscheck evidence but may never be promoted into calendar-year 2019 rows.
audits.hindlow: Official EA permit identity is strong; 2016 BEIS 142 kt and 2018 D2N2 169,143 t are historical context only. Existing 2019 candidate 172,000 t remains confidence 98 with no artificial upgrade.
audits.brierlow: Official EA permit identity is strong; 2018 D2N2 165,180 t is historical context only. Existing 2019 candidate 149,000 t remains confidence 98 with no artificial upgrade.
audits.hope: 2016 and 2018 values do not resolve the existing 2019 scope/value conflict; facility HOLD remains unchanged.
audits.power_station_year_guard: 2018 Cottam/Ratcliffe/Staythorpe/West Burton values are not used to overwrite or validate 2019 masses; West Burton multi-EUTL 2019 split remains fail-closed.
audits.biomass_semantics: Templeborough claim of 150,000 tonnes CO2 avoided per year is avoided-emissions context, not actual annual site emission mass, and is rejected for gas-emissions candidate creation.
audits.pdf_visual_check: Official BEIS PDF text was parsed. A required screenshot attempt of the relevant PDF page was made previously and returned cache miss; this technical limitation remains recorded rather than treated as success.
audits.direct_registry_policy: Direct official EEA/Union Registry installation-row readback remains unavailable; linked EUTL rows cannot be upgraded beyond 98 from lineage alone.
audits.new_candidate_policy: No new target-year 2019 candidate or confidence upgrade was justified in Part78; quality gain is explicit year separation and stronger historical/permit provenance.

quality.confidence_policy: Do not increase target-year confidence from historical-year numeric agreement or current permit identity alone.
quality.year_policy: Explicit calendar-year 2019 mass is mandatory for new numeric promotion; 2016/2018 values remain historical context.
quality.aggregate_policy: Avoided-emissions, group totals, component sums and aggregate/regional values are not facility annual emission substitutes.
quality.zero_policy: Missing 2019 values are NO_DATA and never inferred as zero.
